intelligence.human_view: Think of it like a singer on a stage with a light show that dances to the music — except the lights are dancing to their own song while the singer sings another. You hear the voice fine, but the lights don't move when the voice gets loud and don't rest when it pauses. The visual has to listen to the real voice — loud when he speaks, still when he pauses — the way PowerCast does. Until then the visualizer is decoration, not a visualizer.
intelligence.simple_view: The picture is supposed to dance with the words! But it just sits there, dancing its own dance, while the words go by! It has to listen to the real voice — big when he talks loud, still when he stops! Like PowerCast!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — the picture is supposed to dance with the words, dear! But it just sits there, dancing its own dance, while the words go by! It has to listen to the real voice, love — big when he talks loud, still when he stops, just like PowerCast!
intelligence.naya_view: Make the visualizer listen to the real sound. The visual must move with the words — louder when he speaks, still when he pauses — the amplitude of the actual audio driving the canvas, not a play-state animation that flows on its own. Play-state morphing is not sync and never counts as sync. The checker proves the visual tracks the words: speak, and the visual jumps; pause, and the visual rests. Until that handshake is proven, the visualizer is decoration, and decoration is not shipped as a feature.
